concepts.name: ResultEnvelope
concepts.definition:
Universal response wrapper for all editor operations carrying success flag,
optional error code, message, detail dict, and diagnostics list.

concepts.name: ErrorCode
concepts.definition:
Centralised enum of all typed error codes used across every subsystem.
Invariant: every possible typed error must appear here; no subsystem
defines its own ad-hoc error strings.

concepts.name: Diagnostic
concepts.definition:
Structured diagnostic message produced by validation or error handling,
carrying a code, human message, optional path, and detail dict.

concepts.name: ValidationResult
concepts.definition: Result of a validation operation: success flag and list of Diagnostic items.

concepts.name: OperationResult
concepts.definition:
Result of a mutating operation: success flag, optional typed error code,
message, and diagnostics list.

concepts.name: WriteAllResult
concepts.definition:
Result of a bulk-save operation listing written, failed, and skipped
buffer IDs.

concepts.name: SessionKey
concepts.definition:
UUID4 string that uniquely and permanently identifies one session.
Invariant: never reused after session close.

concepts.name: SessionDescriptor
concepts.definition:
Point-in-time snapshot of session state returned by connect/status
operations.

concepts.name: BufferDescriptor
concepts.definition: Point-in-time snapshot of buffer metadata included in SessionDescriptor.

concepts.name: BufferAddress
concepts.definition:
Opaque pair of buffer_id and formatter-specific address. Invariant:
address content is never interpreted by editor core — only by the
owning formatter.

concepts.name: Buffer
concepts.definition:
Binding of exactly one file (or unsaved content) to exactly one formatter
for the lifetime of an open buffer. Both formatter and buffer_id are
immutable after open.

concepts.name: BufferState
concepts.definition:
Snapshot of buffer's current state returned by get_state, including a
formatter-rendered skeleton preview.

concepts.name: FormatterRegistry
concepts.definition:
Singleton registry mapping file extensions and formatter names to formatter
classes. Invariant: one extension maps to exactly one formatter.

concepts.name: CodeAnalysisClient
concepts.definition:
Single gateway for all project file I/O via the CA server API. Invariant:
ai_editor never reads or writes project files directly from disk.

concepts.name: FileLock
concepts.definition:
Server-side cooperative file lock, keyed by (ca_session_id, project_id, file_id) in the
CA server's session_file_locks table. Acquired via session_open_file when a writable
remote buffer is opened; released via session_close_file on buffer close, save(close=True),
or startup_sweep recovery. The ca_session_id is an EXTERNAL user/chat session (see CASession);
ai_editor never creates or deletes it. Invariant: a file locked by one CA session is
unavailable to any other (BUFFER_LOCKED). Readonly buffers acquire no lock.

concepts.name: Writer
concepts.definition:
Local disk write utilities with two distinct responsibilities: write_buf
for session buf files only; write_result for local derived artifacts only.
Neither writes project files.

concepts.name: AiEditorConfig
concepts.definition:
Configuration section 'ai_editor' in config.json providing formatter
thresholds and session base directory.

concepts.name: CodeAnalysisServerConfig
concepts.definition:
Configuration section 'code_analysis_server' in config.json for CA server
connection (host, port, protocol, mTLS or token auth).

concepts.name: AiEditorConfigValidator
concepts.definition:
Validator that extends adapter BaseValidator; validates ai_editor and
code_analysis_server config sections inside the adapter's validation pipeline.

concepts.name: AiEditorConfigGenerator
concepts.definition:
Config generator that extends adapter SimpleConfigGenerator; calls super
first, then appends ai_editor and code_analysis_server sections to
produced config.json.

concepts.name: AbstractFormatter
concepts.definition: Base class for every format. Owns the in-memory Tree, all structural operations over it, stable_id identity, Sidecar production, and write orchestration. Subclasses implement conversion hooks only. Invariant: formatters must not know about sessions, session_key, buf files, git, or buffer registry.

concepts.name: FormatterCommandCatalog
concepts.definition:
Structured catalogue of all standard and formatter-specific commands with
OpenAPI-compatible input/output schemas.

concepts.name: FormatterUnit
concepts.definition: Addressable unit within the formatter Tree for navigation and search. address is node stable_id (UUID). Carries unit_kind, display_text, metadata.

concepts.name: SkeletonOptions
concepts.definition:
Configuration for render_skeleton controlling depth, hint fields, collapse
threshold, string preview length, and line offset.

concepts.name: TextFormatter
concepts.definition: Converter-only subclass for plain text files. Document model is a two-level paragraph/line tree (not list[str]). Structure, navigation, mutation, and identity are owned by AbstractFormatter base.

concepts.name: YamlFormatter
concepts.definition: Converter-only subclass for YAML using ruamel.yaml round-trip. Structure, navigation, mutation, and identity owned by base class.

concepts.name: PlanTaskV1
concepts.definition:
Semantic validation schema for plan task YAML files. Validates format,
kind, depends_on, commands uniqueness, schema references, verification
presence, and status values.

concepts.name: JsonFormatter
concepts.definition: Converter-only subclass for JSON. Structure, navigation, mutation, and identity owned by base class. No comment preservation.

concepts.name: CSTFormatter
concepts.definition: Specialisation of AbstractFormatter for Python (.py) using libcst. Provides CST-specific parse/render converters; tree ownership and structural ops remain in base class. Default view is declarative skeleton.

concepts.name: CSTTree
concepts.definition: CST specialisation of Tree: in-memory Python CST with libcst.Module, metadata_map, node_map, and stable_id survival through mutations.

concepts.name: StableId
concepts.definition: UUID4 node identity assigned once by AbstractFormatter base class at tree build for every format. Never reassigned on replace_node; maintained through structural ops. Subclasses never assign, read, or depend on stable_ids. For CST, transient # @node-id embedding during mutation is stripped before any write.

concepts.name: Sidecar
concepts.definition: Persisted tree file for every format. Session-side after every mutation; project-side on save. Generic header TREE_V1 fmt=<formatter> sha256=<source> tree_sha256=<tree>. CST uses .cst paths and CST_TREE_V1 as a specialisation.

concepts.name: DeclarativeSkeleton
concepts.definition:
Default view of a .py buffer: structural overview of visible nodes each
prefixed with [stable_id]. Method/function bodies replaced by placeholder.

concepts.name: DocstringMeta
concepts.definition:
Structured docstring stored in TreeNodeMetadata, migrating with the node
through mutations via stable_id. Parsed from Google-style sections.

concepts.name: AbstractSearch
concepts.definition:
Interface for searching within a formatter's document model. Does not open
or write files. Returns SearchMatch items carrying formatter-specific
addresses usable directly in BufferAddress.

concepts.name: SearchMatch
concepts.definition:
Single search result carrying a formatter-specific address, a text preview,
unit kind, and metadata. Address is directly usable in BufferAddress.

concepts.name: SearchQuery
concepts.definition:
Typed search query with kind, value, and options fields.
Formatter-specific query kinds are allowed.

concepts.name: Session
concepts.definition:
Collection of open buffers sharing a session directory, session git repo,
and clipboard. Invariant: one session = one directory on disk; session
survives process restart as long as directory exists. Operates under an
EXTERNAL CASession (ca_session_id), supplied at creation; the editor uses but
does not own that CA session and never calls session_create / session_delete.
The editor's session responsibility is exactly two things: lock each fetched
file (session_open_file) and isolate locked files across CA sessions.
session.close releases all file locks (session_close_file) and deletes the
session directory, but never deletes the CA session itself.

concepts.name: SessionDirectory
concepts.definition:
Root directory of a session on local disk holding all session artifacts.
Invariant: session exists iff directory exists.

concepts.name: SessionGit
concepts.definition:
Non-bare git repository inside the session directory. One branch per open
buffer (buf/<buffer_id>). Commit on every mutation and clipboard cut/copy.
Used for undo/redo.

concepts.name: Clipboard
concepts.definition:
Session-scoped clipboard holding the last copied or cut fragment. When
source formatter differs from target formatter, ConversionRegistry is
consulted; CLIPBOARD_FORMAT_MISMATCH returned if no rule exists.

concepts.name: SessionAttributes
concepts.definition:
Persistent session state stored in ses_settings.json, including
session_key, created_at, readonly flag, open buffer descriptors, and
per-buffer redo_stack.

concepts.name: BufferFile
concepts.definition:
Local copy of a file's content in the session directory, written by
write_buf after every mutation. Not the project file — only the session
working copy.

concepts.name: StartupSweep
concepts.definition:
Recovery procedure on ai_editor startup that releases stale file locks for all
locked buffers recorded in orphaned ses_settings.json from previous sessions, and
removes orphaned session directories. Locks are released via session_close_file
under the session's ca_session_id. The external CA session itself is never deleted.

concepts.name: EditorCommand
concepts.definition:
Command unit following metadatastd.md: three-file structure
(command/schema/metadata), registered via HooksRegister, auto-generates
JSON-RPC/OpenAPI/MCP surface via mcp_proxy_adapter.

concepts.name: HooksRegister
concepts.definition:
Module hooks_register.py that registers all EditorCommands and all
Formatters with their respective registries on startup. Also registers
all ConversionRules in ConversionRegistry.

concepts.name: ApiFacade
concepts.definition:
ai_editor/api.py providing thin synchronous wrapper functions over the
session layer, consumed by CLI and integration tests.

concepts.name: CLI
concepts.definition:
Thin diagnostic wrapper ai_editor/interfaces/cli.py over ApiFacade.
Console script target: ai_editor.interfaces.cli:main.

concepts.name: StartupSequence
concepts.definition:
Ordered initialisation in main.py: load config, validate, build ASGI app,
register commands and formatters, run server via UnifiedServerRunner.

concepts.name: ProxyRegistration
concepts.definition:
Automatic registration of the ai_editor server instance on mcp-proxy at
startup, with heartbeat and auto-unregister on shutdown.

concepts.name: ServiceManager
concepts.definition: scripts/aiedmgr console script for process lifecycle management.

concepts.name: MarkdownFormatter
concepts.definition:
Formatter for Markdown files (.md, .markdown) using mistune>=3.0 AST.
Promotes Markdown from TextFormatter fallback to a first-class structural
formatter with heading/paragraph/code-block/list/table node types.

concepts.name: MdNode
concepts.definition:
Document model node for MarkdownFormatter wrapping a mistune AST node
with structural metadata.

concepts.name: XmlFormatter
concepts.definition:
Formatter for XML files (.xml, .xsd, .xsl, .xslt, .svg) using lxml>=5.0.
Preserves comments, processing instructions, and namespace declarations.
Supports XPath 1.0 addressing and optional XSD schema validation.

concepts.name: HtmlFormatter
concepts.definition:
Formatter for HTML files (.html, .htm, .xhtml) using beautifulsoup4>=4.12
with lxml parser. Lenient HTML parsing, CSS selector addressing, preserves
doctype and comments.

concepts.name: ConversionRegistry
concepts.definition:
Registry of cross-formatter conversion rules enabling clipboard paste
between different formatter types. Called by Clipboard.paste when source
formatter != target formatter. Returns CLIPBOARD_FORMAT_MISMATCH if no
rule exists for the pair.

concepts.name: ConversionRule
concepts.definition:
Single entry in ConversionRegistry describing how to convert a fragment
from one formatter to another, with lossiness flag and description.

concepts.name: PortedCodeBase
concepts.definition: Set of files copied verbatim from code-analysis-server into ai_editor/ported/ as the starting point for Scenario B adaptation.

concepts.name: StandaloneAdapter
concepts.definition: Set of thin shim modules replacing code-analysis-server infrastructure dependencies so PortedCodeBase runs without DB or mcp_proxy_adapter.

concepts.name: ImportRewrite
concepts.definition: Mechanical transformation of import statements in PortedCodeBase files replacing code_analysis and mcp_proxy_adapter namespaces with ai_editor namespaces.

concepts.name: TextGroupReadiness
concepts.definition: Invariant state where ai_editor/ported/ is importable standalone and the text format group is fully functional without code-analysis-server on the Python path.

concepts.name: CASession
concepts.definition:
External user/login session on the CA server (e.g. the chat session), identified by
ca_session_id. Created OUTSIDE ai_editor at user login and shared with other consumers
(terminal sessions, other tools). ai_editor receives ca_session_id at editor-session
creation and uses it to acquire/release per-file locks (session_open_file /
session_close_file) and to enforce cross-session file isolation. ai_editor NEVER calls
session_create or session_delete and never owns the CA session lifecycle; the CA session
outlives any editor session.

concepts.name: Tree
concepts.definition: In-memory node tree owned by AbstractFormatter base; produced by open_tree/parse, consumed by render/export; one per open buffer.

concepts.name: TreeNode
concepts.definition: Single node in the generic Tree: stable_id, node_kind, line range, display_text, metadata, children.

concepts.name: SourceOfTruth
concepts.definition: Rule governing which artifact is authoritative: source file at open; tree file once buffer.modified is True.

concepts.name: AutoCreateTree
concepts.definition: Automatic tree build when preview finds no tree file, and immediately after fetch from analysis server.

concepts.name: WritePipeline
concepts.definition: Base-class write orchestration: export via subclass render, diff preview, temp file, subclass linters, atomic rename on success; abort and return errors on lint failure.
